legend: Dome-shaped cellular dermal nodule composed of spindled cells arranged in short fascicles and whorls.
Spindled cells directly beneath the epidermis, with fascicles growing perpendicular to the surface.
High-power view demonstrates spindled cells with elongated, cytologically bland nuclei and rounded, eosinophilic paranuclear inclusions that often indent the nucleus.
Gömöri trichrome stain highlights the intracytoplasmic inclusions (red).
